verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API access to individual verification results, including images and extracted data, using a secret key. There is no documented bulk or self-serve export of all account data, no statement about open export formats, and no offboarding path. Per-record API retrieval is a developer building block for building an export, not the export capability itself, and the docs say only 'most' details are accessible, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
